text:
michael: Quick run-through: I want a compact GA acceptance "mini-gate" we can tick off this week. Keep it practical — ops+commercial sign-off only.
anya: post the mini-gate bullets here please.
michael: my proposed mini-gate: 1) agreed SLA bullets + compensation cap, 2) one public quickstart + one internal ops playbook, 3) oncall rota documented, 2 runbooks (rollback + latency emergency), 4) monitoring + 2 regression alerts, 5) pricing/quota mapping for committed tiers, 6) private/dedicated deployment appendix (KMS, audit logs), 7) a rehearsed canary + a simple smoke script.
tomo: suggest we call out DNS failover rehearsal explicitly — ran into ~20m propagation last time.
rachel: commercial asks that SLA credits be capped to a percentage of monthly invoice and require repeated incidents threshold for escalation. I'll draft numbers.
infra-bot: FYI: last dedicated roll had DNS propagation delta ~18m; recommend test with TTL change and timed cutover.
michael: good point. tomo, can you own the DNS rehearse and add steps to the runbook?
tomo: yep. I'll add a small checklist: set low TTL in staging, simulate region outage, measure RTO/RPO, record steps. Will add ./runbooks/dns_failover.md PR.
anya: monitoring: propose 2 regression alerts: token-cost/unit delta > 15% and 30m median latency > 20% baseline. Also a quality drift alert (embedding-similarity drop) for embedding routes.
rachel: commercial: want explicit language in public SLA that scheduled maintenance (72h notice) is excluded and credits are capped at 1 month invoice or X dollars (I'll propose X in doc). Also want a short remediation timeline commitment.
legal-bot: reminder: include an exceptions clause for force majeure and a short private-deploy audit wording.
michael: owners: SLA wording (rachel + legal-bot), monitoring dashboards (anya), canary + smoke script (tomo), runbooks + oncall rota (michael), pricing/quota appendix (rachel).
tomo: smoke script idea: ./ci/ga_smoke.sh that fires 120 requests from two regions, flips a region flag mid-run, asserts fallback < 5% and 5xx < 2%. Keep it parameterized to lower load if ap-south constrained.
anya: good. I'll build grafana panels: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, token-cost/unit, fallback-rate. Link them to the regression alerts.
michael: SLO proposals: p95 small-models < 150ms, medium < 350ms, large < 600ms; data-plane uptime 99.9%. Are those conservative enough for GA?
rachel: commercial OK on those but needs an escalation ladder if we breach more than 2 months in a row. Also require a credit cap. I'll draft the cap and escalation ladder.
infra-bot: infra note: ap-south GPU pool at 70% this week; if you need dual-region rehearsals consider smaller synthetic token sizes or use alternate region pair.
tomo: noted, smoke script will accept --tokensize param.
anya: regression alert: also trigger a soft alert (non-pager) if token-cost increase 8-15% so we catch early. Hard pager at >=15%.
michael: sign-off group for the mini-gate: PM, Eng lead, Infra lead, SRE, Legal. We'll meet Friday 3pm for final tick. Drafts due Thursday EOD.
rachel: flagged: need migration notes for Dedicated customers when moving from hosted quotas to reserved capacity — I'll add a short appendix.
legal-bot: request: add a one-paragraph data-retention + audit-log headline for private installs and note KMS rotation responsibility.
michael: blockers?
tomo: blocked on infra confirming we can schedule a DNS rehearse in staging — pinging infra leads.
anya: blocked on baseline numbers for a couple of large models; pinging runtime team.
rachel: blocked on final credit cap number from finance; I'll chase.
michael: ok — I'll assemble the mini-gate one-pager after PRs land and drop into #shiproom. If anyone posts a draft, add the PR link here. Thanks :thumbsup:
